notes: Every build hides most of its middle in a pinned stage. V11 (~92% flat) and V02 (~85%) least fairly assessable - for V11 effectively only scene 00 was seen. Conversely V03, V04, V05, V06, V09, V10 revealed most of their acts, AN ASYMMETRY THAT LIKELY WORKS AGAINST THE MORE AGGRESSIVELY PINNED BUILDS. EXCLUDING DIMENSION 2 PENALISES THE INPUT-THESIS BUILDS SPECIFICALLY: V03, V06, V09, V10 all print pointer instructions whose payoff is invisible in stills. Large cluster V01/V02/V04/V05/V07/V08/V11 shares near-black ground, amber accent, persistent bottom transport with SMPTE timecode, five or six named acts; several repeat 'scroll to scrub' and 'Motion: Full/Reduced' almost verbatim. Second cluster V03/V06/V10 uses a stiffness/damping slider panel as its third act. V09 sole outlier: only light ground, only day-cycle acts. Most common failure: fixed chrome colliding with flowing text. Mobile markedly weaker than desktop across the whole pool.
